title: NCRTC Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut RRTS Corridor: BIM from Detailed Design to As-Built
author: BIM Earth Consultancy
excerpt: How BIM Earth Consultancy supported Datamatics India with BIM modelling, Revit family creation, clash detection and asset management across the RRTS corridor.
content:
**Project Name:** Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut RRTS Corridor
**Client:** Datamatics India
**Consultancy:** BIM Earth Consultancy
**Scope of Work:** BIM Modelling, Family Creation, Coordination, Clash Detection & Asset Management
**Project Stages:** Detailed Design to As-Built Stage

### Project Overview

BIM Earth Consultancy provided comprehensive BIM modelling and information management services for the NCRTC Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut Corridor project for Datamatics India. The scope covered the development and management of BIM models from the Detailed Design stage through to the As-Built stage, supporting multidisciplinary coordination, design validation, clash resolution, and asset information management. The project required structured BIM workflows to maintain accurate and coordinated digital information throughout the project lifecycle.

### Scope of Services

- Development and updating of BIM models in accordance with project requirements.
- Creation and placement of project-specific Revit families.
- Multidisciplinary BIM coordination and model integration.
- Identification and management of design conflicts through clash detection.
- Coordination and resolution of clashes between different disciplines and systems.
- Updating BIM models based on design revisions and site requirements.
- Development and maintenance of models from Detailed Design to As-Built stage.
- Incorporation of relevant asset information into the BIM environment.
- Asset management and structured information development for project handover.
- Maintaining model accuracy and consistency throughout the project lifecycle.

### Project Outcome

BIM Earth Consultancy successfully supported the project through BIM modelling, family creation, multidisciplinary coordination, clash detection, and asset management services from the Detailed Design stage to As-Built stage. The structured BIM approach helped improve coordination, identify and resolve design conflicts at an early stage, and maintain reliable digital project information for effective construction coordination and asset management.
